sloka: महत्सत्त्वमिदं ज्ञेयं कपिरूपं व्यवस्थितम् ।प्रयत्नं महदास्थाय क्रियतामस्य निग्रहः ।। ५.४६.१२।।।।
transliteration: mahatsattvamidaṁ jñeyaṁ kapirūpaṁ vyavasthitam ।prayatnaṁ mahadāsthāya kriyatāmasya nigrahaḥ ।। 5.46.12।।।।

translations.english: "It should be understood that he has taken the form of a monkey. You have to put in extraordinary effort to capture him by acting in a suitable manner.
translations.hindi: लुम रावण की इस पुरी में राने का ठीक-ठीक कारण बतला दो । जब प्रहृस्त ने इस प्रकार कपिश्रेष्ठ से कहा
